item.nusmp.moonfang_zangetsu.desc: A black cleaver wound in bandage at the hilt, the spirit of a sword that has worn the shape of a soul-reaper's blade. Its edge keeps the cold light of a moon that is not in the sky. 25% more damage on every blow; slowness for 3 seconds on the foe. Use: Moon Cleave, Crescent Fang and Final Moon.
item.nusmp.moonfang_zangetsu.card:
God Grade greatsword (240 damage, 1.1 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 25% more damage on every blow; slowness for 3 seconds on the foe.
While held: +0.15 attack speed, +8 maximum health, 25% less magic damage, the lent skill strengthen body.
Moon Cleave (use; cooldown 20 s, 6% magicules): A great arc of moonlit force: every foe in a 170 degree cone within 9 blocks takes a heavy cut and is slowed.

Tensura engravings: severance, magic weapon, barrier piercing, elemental boost.
item.nusmp.ruyi_power_pole.desc: A lacquered red pole with a gold cap at each end, a rod that grows to touch the sky when asked and shrinks to a pencil when not. It has carried more than one monkey up a tower. 20% more damage on every blow; glowing for 6 seconds on the foe. Use: Pole Vault, Grow Long and Sky Tower Smash.

Tensura engravings: crushing, swift, sturdy, vigor.
item.nusmp.ackerman_twin_blades.desc: A pair of ultrahard steel blades from the guard of a hundred-year wall, the last word of the family that never lost a duel to anything its own size.
